subject: The confession I wasn't going to make about this month
preview_text: Our community just scanned 47,832 messages. What we found will change how you see everything.
body_paragraphs: I almost didn't send this email. The numbers from this month's community scans just came in, and they're so wild I had to check them twice. It's like we all collectively opened our eyes at the same time.

Your fellow users scanned 47,832 messages in the last 30 days. The AI flagged gaslighting in 31% of them. Love bombing patterns in 22%. But here's the part that got me: 68% of people who got a high toxicity score said their gut had been whispering the same thing for weeks. The app just gave them permission to listen. That's 800+ people who saw the pattern before it became a prison.

This is why the Pattern History feature exists. It's not just about one sketchy text. It's about connecting dots across weeks or months that your hopeful heart tries to ignore. Seeing it laid out in your dashboard removes the doubt. It turns that quiet 'something feels off' into a clear, undeniable map.

Open the app right now and tap 'View My Patterns'. Let it analyze your last few scans together. See what story the dots tell. Don't wait for the pattern to become a scar. P.S. The users who check their Pattern History weekly are 3x more likely to message me saying 'I caught it early, thank you.' Be one of them.
